note: Leonida Ledger guide notes, written for GTA VI on PS5. Every note is built from the official trophy description plus clearly labelled own advice; the game is unreleased, so nothing here is checked in the game yet.

steps: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own.
Use the checklist view to see what is left, and the roadmap view to order the last few.
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and follow its objectives to the end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes, so there is nothing extra to collect first.
Play through Chapter 1 to its closing mission.
Keep following the story prompts; side activities can wait until later.
Play through Chapter 2 to its closing mission.
The chapter ends on a story beat, so no optional objective gates it.
Play through Chapter 3 to its closing mission.
By now the map opens up, but the chapter trophy only needs the story done.
Play through Chapter 4 to its closing mission.
Stock up on ammo and armour before the chapter's later fights — own advice, not yet checked in the game.
